subject: System Design
title: ETA Prediction
description: Learn ETA Prediction in one minute.

hook.text: Uber says your driver arrives in 4 minutes. You wait exactly 4 minutes. How did it predict so accurately?

buildup.text: ETA prediction uses historical trip data, current traffic conditions, road type, and time of day as features.

discovery.text: Machine learning models trained on billions of past trips learn that this road at 5pm on Friday always has traffic.

twist.text: ETAs must update in real time. An accident ahead that didn't exist 30 seconds ago changes the prediction entirely.

climax.text: Accurate ETAs build user trust. Being off by 2 minutes feels fine; off by 10 feels like a broken product.

punchline.text: Billions of past trips train models to predict your wait.

quiz.question: What makes ETA prediction challenging?
options: Real-time events like accidents can change predictions instantly
